spec.name: openclaw_rwasdk_ankara_patterns
spec.purpose: Gateway-as-control-plane discipline with skills as plain-text directories and policy enforced by code, an RWA read-only query shape with normalised yield and compliance models, and an asset-template factory shape with local identity hooks and an explicit open-core boundary, all restated in our own words

summary: Patterns from openclaw/openclaw (MIT), chainstacklabs/rwa-sdk (MIT) and ankarachain/ankara-core (MIT): a gateway-as-control-plane discipline where one local control plane owns sessions, tools, events and channel connections and every UI is a client of it, with skills as plain-text instruction directories, plugins packaging channels/providers/tools/skills, policy enforced by code (inbound messages untrusted, explicit pairing approval), and opt-in-only telemetry with a single disable flag; an RWA read-only query shape returning typed records (symbol, price, tvl, yield type, compliance method, price source naming the exact read) with four yield patterns normalised (accumulating / rebasing / ERC-4626 vault / dividend mint) and seven compliance methods behind one can_transfer-style check, with adapters validated at injection time; and an asset-template factory shape with six named asset classes behind one factory plus registry plus escrow manager, identity hooks shaped for the jurisdiction's real documents, and an explicit open-core boundary stating what is open and what is a paid tier. All restated in our own words, stdlib-only, no provider/network/API-key/server/MCP/GPU/model-weight/payment/key/custody code.
